keywords: The Petitioner sought the intervention of this Court to compel the 1 st Respondent to issue R.B.4/F.L.4 liquor license; Petitioner\'s duly filled application submitted along with the necessary documents were approved by the 2nd Respondent as the final authority. Held – refusal or withholding issuance of license by the 1st Respondent is ultra vires, capricious, irrational, and violation of duty. Writs issued with costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
